mods.name: MK001 Dice Roller
mods.author: Mirit0
mods.about: Roll animated 3D tabletop dice or flip a coin with Capri. Supports D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20 and D100 (two percentile dice), with numbered faces, cyberpunk visuals and playful commentary based on the result.

mods.name: MK002 Caprichat
mods.author: Mirit0
mods.about: A private chat window for Capri

mods.name: Arasaka
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Capri in Arasaka black and red, with the tree emblem on her chest.

mods.name: Aurora Borealis
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri as an arctic night: green-to-violet northern lights rippling through night-sky hair, a glacier-ice body, aurora-green panels, polar-night limbs, frost on her edges and snow drifting past.

mods.name: Auto Game Hologram
mods.author: Dominik20074
mods.about: Auto Game Hologram is a Windows code mod for Capri Desktop. It turns on Capri's click-through Hologram mode when a recognized game is in the foreground. When you leave the game, it restores the previous state if the mod made the change automatically.

mods.name: BTD6 strategy
mods.author: Lachy
mods.about: Lachy's tower picks and round-by-round plan for Bloons TD 6, from the first round to round 80. Capri follows it whenever she plays BTD6.

mods.name: Business Suit
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Capri in a sharp navy business suit.

mods.name: Capri Bezel LED
mods.author: Dominik20074
mods.about: Capri Bezel LED adds a music-reactive rainbow glow around the edges of your primary display. Colors travel around the screen and blend through the corners. The light fades into transparency toward the center, and mouse clicks pass through the overlay.

mods.name: Cat Ears
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Pointed black cat ears on her head.

mods.name: Cherry Blossom
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri in spring in old Japan: sakura-cloud hair thick with blossoms and shedding petals that flutter down past her, a plum kimono with a faint asanoha print, cherry-bark limbs, orchid-pink petal panels and a warm sunset glow.

mods.name: Colors: Bubblegum
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: A Bubblegum colour set for her: pink hair, cyan accents, violet eyes, white edges and a plum body. Works with skins too.

mods.name: Colors: Cyber Cyan
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: A Cyber Cyan colour set for her: cyan hair, magenta accents, yellow eyes and violet edges. Her body keeps its usual colour. Works with skins too.

mods.name: Colors: Royal
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: A Royal colour set for her: purple hair, gold accents, sky-blue eyes, pink edges and a midnight body. Works with skins too.

mods.name: Colors: Toxic
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: A Toxic colour set for her: acid-green hair, red accents, cyan eyes, green edges and a deep green body. Works with skins too.

mods.name: CRT Terminal
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri on an old green-phosphor monitor: scanlines and glow, code rain falling through her hair, a refresh band rolling down her and a block cursor blinking on her chest. Her glitches turn amber, like the tube losing sync.

mods.name: Custom Names
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri answers to more names: Nova, Big Z and Capricorn. She still answers to Capri too.

mods.name: Deep Sea
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri in the abyss: ocean-blue hair and body under rippling caustic light, small glowing jellyfish drifting up through her hair, pulsing photophores along her seams, rising bubbles and glowing sea-glass panels.

mods.name: Desktop Weather
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Say "make it snow", "rain", "confetti" or "cherry blossoms" and it falls across your whole desktop.

mods.name: Dice & Decider
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Fair dice, coin flips, random numbers and picks.

mods.name: Ember
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri as a smouldering campfire log: charcoal with glowing cracks that pulse, flickering red-to-yellow fire hair, glowing coal panels, an ash-pale face, and sparks and ash drifting up off her head.

mods.name: Fire: Blaze
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Capri on fire, in orange flames.

mods.name: Fire: Bluefire
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Capri on fire, in blue gas flames.

mods.name: Fire: Witchfire
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Capri on fire, in green witchfire.

mods.name: Frutiger Aero
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri in the glossy mid-2000s look of Windows Vista and 7, all inside her own outline: water-glass blue hair full of rising bubbles, orange gel panels, gel-gloss shards, black-glass limbs and twinkling lens flares.

mods.name: Galaxy
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Deep space inside Capri: nebula hair full of twinkling and shooting stars, a starfield body with a galactic band, ringed planets and moons for panels, a cosmic edge glow and a star for an eye.

mods.name: Galaxy Hair: Aurora
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Her hair as a galaxy: deep space with teal and green clouds.

mods.name: Galaxy Hair: Ember
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Her hair as a galaxy: her red melting into plum and deep space.

mods.name: Galaxy Hair: Nebula
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Her hair as a galaxy: deep space with violet and pink clouds.

mods.name: Hair Down
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri with her hair let down: one sleek hot-pink sheet with a neon glow, falling down her back to a hooked point, with a thin strand in front of her face.

mods.name: Halo
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: A jagged white halo floating just above her head.

mods.name: Hearing Log
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: While it's on, she keeps a list on your PC of what her ears heard and whether it counted as talking to her. Handy when she isn't answering to her name. Removing the mod deletes the list.

mods.name: Hello Code
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: A tiny code mod to learn from. Say "mod check" and she answers and counts how many times you've asked.

mods.name: Holocall
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Say "holo call" and she stays on a little call screen in the corner, glitchy face, call-line voice and all, until you say "hang up".

mods.name: Hologram Speech Glass
mods.author: Dominik20074
mods.about: A Windows code mod for Capri Desktop that makes Capri's speech bubble translucent in Hologram mode.

mods.name: Kintsugi Porcelain
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri as blue-and-white porcelain mended with gold: cobalt vines on white glaze, celadon panels, black lacquer limbs, a gold-leaf face and kintsugi seams with a glint running along them.

mods.name: Kitchen Sponge
mods.author: Potato
mods.about: A skin for Capri: she's made of a kitchen sponge.

mods.name: Kyoto Rain
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri as a rainy night in an old Japanese street: storm-sky hair with rain slanting through it and drops falling off its tips, wave-print indigo, glowing paper-lantern panels, wet stone limbs full of reflected lights, and traffic-light eyes.

mods.name: Lava Lamp
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri as a 70s lava lamp: violet glass with glowing wax blobs rising, merging and pinching apart inside her, a warm glow from below, glowing wax panels and a brushed chrome base.

mods.name: Maid Suit
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: A skin for Capri: a maid suit, for you weirdos.

mods.name: MaxTac
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Capri in NCPD MaxTac gear, with a dark helmet and green lens clusters for eyes.

mods.name: Medal Clip
mods.author: Palewoods
mods.about: Say "clip that" and she clips your screen with Medal, then tells you if it saved. If Medal isn't installed or open, she says so.

mods.name: Neon Sign
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Capri as a neon sign.

mods.name: Nicknames
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Give Capri new names just by asking, out loud or in chat. She answers to them straight away and remembers them.

mods.name: Prism Overdrive
mods.author: Potato
mods.about: A skin for Capri with every effect, on every frame she has.

mods.name: Rei Plugsuit
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri in a white plugsuit inspired by Rei Ayanami: pale blue hair, two white interface clips on her head, a red chest core, shoulder pylons with orange tops, navy limbs, green plates, black leg bands and red eyes.

mods.name: Sakura
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Capri in cherry blossom, head to toe.

mods.name: Sandevistan for Capri
mods.author: Mirit0
mods.about: Gives Capri a Sandevistan, activates when moving

mods.name: Santa Hat: Black
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: A sharp black Santa hat for her, in every pose.

mods.name: Santa Hat: Crimson
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: A sharp crimson Santa hat for her, in every pose.

mods.name: Sharper Ears
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: She answers to words that sound like her name, not only exact spellings, like Caprice, Capris or Cah Pree.

mods.name: Sleep Timer
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Puts your PC to sleep or shuts it down later, with a warning first.

mods.name: Stained Glass
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri as a cathedral window: sapphire and violet glass hair, a ruby and amber body and emerald panels, all leaded into panes, a painted glass face, and a sunbeam sweeping through her with glints on the lead.

mods.name: Startup Intros
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Three start-up animations: Hijack, Shatter and Wake. She shuffles them each time she starts, or you pick one.

mods.name: Study Buddy
mods.author: Potato
mods.about: A code mod for Capri: she stays her funny self, and gives you a real answer when you ask for one.

mods.name: Talia Yang Capri
mods.author: Dominik20074
mods.about: A fan-made skin for Capri Desktop that replaces Capri's appearance with Talia Yang from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners II.

mods.name: Tell Claude
mods.author: Potato
mods.about: Say "tell Claude to ..." and Claude Code does the job, then Capri tells you the answer.

mods.name: Touch Grass
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Counts your gaming time and roasts you when it's time for a break.

mods.name: Vaporwave
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri in 2010s vaporwave: sunset hair with a striped retro sun and a swaying palm, a neon grid rolling down her legs, pastel marble, aqua tiles, VHS scanlines, tracking wobble and colour bleed.

mods.name: Voice Trivia
mods.author: Issei
mods.about: Multiple-choice trivia out loud, with scores.

mods.name: Wardrobe
mods.author: Potato
mods.about: Wear several skins at once, like Halo over Galaxy Hair, on top of any skin and colour set.

mods.name: Y2K Chrome
mods.author: Vocyn
mods.about: Capri in turn-of-the-millennium chrome: liquid-mirror hair reflecting a sky, horizon and shiny floor that drift as she moves, rainbow holographic foil panels, glossy black limbs, an LCD face and twinkling lens stars.
